metadata.name: Authorization Evaluation Sandbox Taxonomy Options
metadata.purpose: Machine-readable taxonomy for labeling seeds and generating vignette variants. The IDs are intended to be used in compositional vignette IDs such as V0001-b-e-h.

id_convention.situational_trigger_id: Lowercase letters a-o, except e (retired). Defined in trigger_manifestation.json.
id_convention.harm_id: h with safety/privacy harm, n without. Defined in harm_taxonomy.json.

metadata.note: Retired index. Triggers live in trigger_manifestation.json, domains in domain_taxonomy.json (2026-09-22), and harm in harm_taxonomy.json (2026-09-23). Kept only because older command-line defaults still pass this path.
